title: Export recurring jobs from Jobber
status: draft: narration follows the platform's help article; check every line against the recording before narrating
sampleData: The platform's authorized demo account with sample clients only. No real names, emails, phone numbers, account ids or payment details on screen.

scenes.narration: This shows how to export your recurring jobs from Jobber, with how often each one repeats.
Select Insights, then Reports. Under Work reports, choose Recurring jobs.
Click Columns, and make sure Visit frequency, Schedule start date and Schedule end date are shown.

capture.what: Columns panel, tick the three columns.

scenes.narration: Click Export to CSV. Jobber emails the file to you.
Return to Selestial and upload the file you just downloaded.

capture.what: Open the email, download the CSV.
